title: Hen_Wen's Recorces
body:
ive been keepiong this pack to myself for a long time now, but i guess i will relese it to the public now, heres what it does:

-changes heart texture (and every version, poison, whither, mount, heart container, even half a hearts look different)
-changes xp bar texture
-changes hotbar texture
-changes crosshair texture
-changes a few random item textures (trident, resin brick, ect)
-changes changes hunger effect on hunger bar

(hope you like it <3)
